findings.summary: Non-blocking (spec §5 reserves REJECT for blockers): after D4 swallows RunExitedWithoutResultError, runChannelWrite still writes the one-shot generate marker, so a generate role that exited without a result leaves the origin permanently marked as generated for that run — the local failure is loud inside the tick (diagnostics) but is folded into 'already generated' for every later tick of the same board. Consider writing the marker only when a report doc was actually published.

D6 test asserts timings.generateMs > 0 with fully mocked generate deps; runGenerate can plausibly complete inside one Date.now() millisecond, which is a jitter risk against acceptance criterion 1 (two consecutive all-green runs). An assertion of >= 0 plus a separate 'generate段被计时' signal would be sturdier.
